body:
The build button added by the C# plugin is just building your C# project. In order to also call `_Build` callbacks, it would actually have to call `EditorNode::get_singleton()->call_build()` but this method is not exposed to scripting so we can't use it. Maybe we should consider exposing it through `EditorInterface`?

That said, I'm not sure if `_Build` callbacks should be called when using the C# build button. The documentation for [`_Build`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_editorplugin.html#class-editorplugin-private-method-build) says the method is called "_when the editor is about to run the project_" and its purpose seems to be "_perform required operations before the project runs_", so while the name may be a bit misleading, maybe it would be more surprising if users have existing plugins that suddenly start executing when building the C# project too.

It would help us to know what you are using the `_Build` callback for in your plugin. Could you consider uploading an MRP that shows the need for executing this callback on building the C# project? Thanks.
